name: Summer Daze: Ifeyo's Adventure
source:
Before coming to the Hero University, Ifeyo Kinah never dreamed that he had magical abilities. Only women used magic in his hometown. Men are supposed to be warriors and leaders. Now that he is a Wizard Apprentice at Hero-U, Ifeyo has just been assigned the task of organizing the university's Harvest Festival and he's never even heard of such a thing.

[From [url=https://www.hero-u.com/]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
来到英雄大学之前，Ifeyo Kinah从未想过自己拥有魔法天赋。在他的家乡，只有女性使用魔法；男性理应成为战士与领袖。如今，身为英雄大学魔法学徒的Ifeyo，刚接到一项任务：筹办学校的丰收节——可他连这种节日都没听说过。

[摘自[url=https://www.hero-u.com/]官方网站[/url]]
